image_manifest.description: A 3D rendered asset manifest showing the race referee for the Racing Marine Reptiles game, positioned just above the water surface.

assets.name: Marine Race Referee
assets.description: A younger male paleontologist character from the DinoGames library (modeled after 'dino_racer_referee_1'). He is wearing a professional scuba mask pushed up onto his forehead, a black-and-white striped referee jersey worn over a high-tech wetsuit top, and his signature thin-rimmed black circular glasses. He is positioned at the water line, waist-deep, holding a starting flag high with one hand.

assets.name: Starting Flag
assets.description: A vibrant, checkered racing flag held high, catching the midday sun.

assets.name: Ocean Surface Environment
assets.description: The surface of a crystal-clear epicontinental seaway with gentle, refractive ripples. The water is a deep cobalt blue, transitioning to a shimmering turquoise near the surface.

assets.name: Visual Effects
assets.description: Small, sparkling water droplets caught in the air around the referee's waist, emphasizing the 'just above water' perspective.

assets.name: Bottom Right Watermark
assets.description: A small, translucent four-pointed star lens-flare logo located in the bottom-right corner.

image_manifest.constraints: No people other than the referee. Square aspect ratio, 1:1. No title bars, borders, or negative space in the composition.
